# AOSP Android 16 r4 source observations

Retrieved from Google's Android source service on 2026-10-29. These are small upstream source files, retained as offline evidence, not an AOSP checkout. Original copyright and Apache-2.0 notices are retained where present. The manifest is repository metadata; distribution/license review of the complete source and prebuilts remains outstanding.

The reviewed repository commits, paths, SHA-256 digests and Git blob IDs are recorded in `apps/api/src/build-targets/cuttlefish.ts`. To locate each observation use `<repository>/+/<commit>/<path>` from that record. The manifest was downloaded through its release tag; the official tag page binds that tag to the recorded commit. Git blob consistency alone does not authenticate a signed release.

Do not execute the retained envsetup script. Tests read bytes only. No `lunch`, Repo sync, source build, image generation or emulator launch was performed.
